# Face-framing test fixture

`astronaut.jpg` is a compact JPEG copy of the NASA portrait distributed by
scikit-image 0.25.2 as `astronaut.png` (same 512 × 512 dimensions).
It is used solely as a public-domain face detector fixture; tests animate its
position and add multiple copies to exercise tracking and subject selection.

- Original fixture: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png
- Source and public-domain notice: https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.21.x/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut
